verdict.rationale: Godot's Node/Scene composition system and EditorInterface (scene saving/loading, mesh previews, inspecting/editing resources) directly support viewport/inspector/scene-composition workflows, and the asset import pipeline plus editor plugin system round out a full in-editor authoring workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming the 'Viewport' panel and 'Inspector' panel UI elements, and independent hands-on artist testimonials specifically praising the visual scene/level-building workflow (community evidence instead focuses on scripting/language experience).
